annotations.text:
All five are the real DevDeck shell — tokens, rail, sidebar and bottom bars lifted from src/index.css and App.tsx.
Mail takes a rail slot next to Stash and reuses the Stash shape: sidebar -> list -> detail, fixed chrome, nothing in the dock.
Click around: groups, filter chips, threads, the reader tabs, Reply.

Open question: contacts sit inside Mail behind a Mail/Contacts switch rather than taking a rail slot of their own.
Cheap to change if you'd rather they were top-level — say which and I'll move it.
